title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Page 109]

items.text: When will they(are they going to) finish their freshman year?
They will be(become) sophomores, won't they?
It's going to(will) take time.
This is a reasonably large area, isn't this?
Some day, he wants to be a language teacher.
When did they have their final examinations?
Sometimes he cut classes, didn't he?
Isn't English a required subject?
German is an elective, isn't it?.
How many English classes does he have a week?
When do they have to pass the final examinations?
When did he open a small grocery store in his hometown?
Within two years, he added another.
Recently he opened a third, didn't he?
They do not have time to get together, do they?
Why does Phil rarely go to the shopping district?
Who likes anything sweet?
When did he recommend a nearby candy shop?
Why did the President criticize the Japanese economy severely?
When did customs agents seize the financial records?
The relief foundation is denying any link to terrorism, isn't it?
I am extremely tall, ain't I?
You are not that tall.
Will I ever play in the NBA?
It is decidedly so.
Why do we always stay here?
It's nicer than my place(house).
I've never seen your place(house).
They don't really come down here that much.
Professor Mcarthy is going to(will) give a difficult examination.
The government was freezing the assets of terrorist groups.
Did the athletes deliver a peak performance?
Where are many athletes training?
How many people have skin cancer?
Hundreds of people have skin cancer, don't they?
